name: 08-strk20-demo
_refresh: Before rendering: capture fresh shots (node scripts/video/capture.mjs; signed-in pages via --base http://localhost:3000 --session <addr>); the receipt scene must show a PRIVATE Starknet settlement once one exists on the fixed route; update the explorer counts.

scenes.title: An AI agent that pays people privately, on Starknet.
The payer is not a person.
scenes.caption: an agent inspects, verifies, decides and pays from a vault it cannot exceed — publicly on GOAT, privately on Starknet

scenes.title: Judge → vault → escrow → claim. No human in the loop.
scenes.caption: the Cairo vault releases the reward to Sage; Sage escrows it behind a Poseidon commitment; the worker opens it — into a shielded note if they choose

scenes.title: Aggregate spend public. Per-recipient private.
scenes.caption: the organization sees what it paid; the ledger never names who — the private-payroll shape, run by an agent

scenes.title: Every settlement and every refusal, on either chain.
scenes.caption: GOAT public payouts and Starknet shielded claims on one tape — a refusal is a code on chain, not a revert

scenes.title: No wallet app to be paid. No signature to receive.
scenes.caption: an email or a Telegram chat is the account; Sage keeps the wallet and pays the gas

scenes.title: Fund once. The agent launches from a treasury under a mandate.
scenes.caption: a per-campaign cap the policy enforces; unspent money can only return to the founder

scenes.title: A record you can borrow against — without a public diary.
scenes.caption: a lender learns that inflow clears a threshold, never the payments that made it

scenes.title: Auditable in aggregate. Private in the destination. Decided by the agent.
scenes.sub: Contracts, transactions and the manifest: sagepays.xyz/strk20.json · open source
